0.0: So, did you decide? Do you want to be a guard?\r\n#L0##bSure! The benefits sound pretty good...#l\n#k
0.1: Great! I commend you, Honorary Member of the Victoria Guards! You're still pretty young but I promise I'll treat you fair and square like other guards!\r\n#L0##bThanks, I look forward to working with you.#l\n#k
0.2: Alright, button it up rookie. For your first assignment, help the beginner explorers who accidentally enter the #bNorth Rocky Mountain#k in #m102000000#. Your job is to help them. Think you can handle that, new meat?

yes.0: All right, then go #bpatrol the North Rocky Mountain#k and help any explorers that you can find. They usually lose their way in #bMini Rocky Road#k. Good luck!

no.0: Hmm. Let me know if you get more confidence.

1.0: Did you help them all? Not bad!!

yes.0: Here, this is your very own Honorary Guard Medal. Treasure it, and I'll call when I have a new assignment for you.

quest.0: You haven't helped a beginner explorer yet? There's bound to be one! Look carefully around #bthe North Rocky Mountain area#k.
